info.title: Student Dropout Early-Warning API
info.description: Estimates the probability that a student withdraws within 30 days of a checkpoint, with non-causal explanations and supportive intervention suggestions. Every risk figure is returned with the model version and a disclaimer. See docs/MODEL_CARD.md for limitations.

post.description: Assign a recommended action. This is the human act ADR-0005 requires.

Score a student on demand.

Takes a student reference, never a raw feature vector: features must come from
the shared builder, or a caller could submit a vector no real student could
produce and the as-of guarantee would mean nothing.

get.description:
Liveness and readiness, reported separately.

Unauthenticated on purpose: a load balancer cannot hold a token.

Minimal operational counters.

Authenticated, because band counts over a cohort are still information about
that cohort.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: These are the factors the model weighted most heavily for this student. They describe the model's behaviour, not the causes of withdrawal, and they are not a judgement about this student. The risk figure is a probability, not a prediction of what will happen.

attribution_basis.title: Attribution Basis
attribution_basis.default: Attributions describe the model's pre-calibration score. They are reported as direction and relative impact, not as an effect on the probability.

InterventionAssignment.title: InterventionAssignment
InterventionAssignment.description: A human assigning a recommended action to themselves or a colleague.

checkpoint_day.title: Checkpoint Day
checkpoint_day.description: Defaults to the student's latest scored checkpoint.

PredictRequest.title: PredictRequest
PredictRequest.description:
Ad-hoc scoring for a student already in the system.

Deliberately does not accept a raw feature vector. Features must be built by
the shared :class:`~dropout_ews.features.builder.FeatureBuilder` from event
data, or the caller could submit a vector that no real student could produce
and the as-of guarantee would mean nothing.

RiskAssessment.title: RiskAssessment
RiskAssessment.description:
A risk figure, and everything needed to read it responsibly.

``disclaimer`` and ``model_version`` are required fields with no default that
can be omitted, so it is not possible to return a probability without them.
